title: Click Bordor Expander
description: Click Bordor Expander adds simple, powerful items that expand the world border instantly.
body:
Click Bordor Expander (CBE)
Click Bordor Expander adds simple, powerful items that expand the world border instantly.

What it does
Right-click a CBE item to run:
/worldborder add <amount>

Each item has a different value, so you can scale your border exactly how you want.

Included Expanders
Bordor Expand: +1
Bordor Expand: +5
Bordor Expand: +10
Bordor Expand: +25
Bordor Expand: +50
Bordor Expand: +100
Bordor Expand: +250
Bordor Expand: +500
Bordor Expand: +1000
Bordor Expand: +2500
Bordor Expand: +5000
Bordor Expand: +10000
Notes
Made for Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.1
Items use a Nether Star icon
Great for challenge worlds, SMP events, and progression-based border gameplay
Example Commands
/give @p cbe:border_expand_plus_1
/give @p cbe:border_expand_plus_10000
